description: OpenAirInterface RF simulator is provided by OpenAirInterface Software Alliance. OpenAirInterface's RF simulator replaces a radio-board driver by transferring samples between simulated network and user equipment. It can apply simple channels such as additive white Gaussian noise and run at a CPU-dependent speed. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: Collaborative Standards Software License v1.0 (OAI), read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Execution may be faster or slower than real time. It is a component-level test facility with simplified channels, not a complete physical deployment model. Potential simulation use: Test OAI protocol and radio-processing behaviour without an RF board.
